home.headline: Learn React & Next.js by building
home.subtitle: Hands-on lessons and interactive Sandpack playgrounds. Write real code, ship real projects, and understand the why behind every pattern.

curriculum.title: Curriculum

lesson.playground_note: This lesson will contain MDX content and an interactive Sandpack playground.
lesson.jsx-and-rendering.title: JSX & Rendering
lesson.jsx-and-rendering.summary: Learn how JSX extends JavaScript to describe UI, how Babel transforms it, and how React reconciles the virtual DOM with the real one.
lesson.components-and-props.title: Components & Props
lesson.components-and-props.summary: Build your first reusable components, pass data down with props, and understand the one-way data flow that makes React predictable.
lesson.state-and-events.title: State & Events
lesson.state-and-events.summary: Manage local state with useState, wire up event handlers, and see how state changes trigger re-renders without you doing anything extra.
lesson.lists-and-keys.title: Lists & Keys
lesson.lists-and-keys.summary: Render dynamic arrays of data, avoid reconciliation bugs by providing stable keys, and filter or sort lists reactively.
lesson.forms-and-controlled-inputs.title: Forms & Controlled Inputs
lesson.forms-and-controlled-inputs.summa: Build controlled form components where React owns the input value, handle validation, and submit data without a full-page reload.
lesson.side-effects-and-useeffect.title: Side Effects & useEffect
lesson.side-effects-and-useeffect.summar: Run code after render, fetch data on mount, subscribe to external systems, and clean up properly to avoid memory leaks.
lesson.context-and-prop-drilling.title: Context & Prop Drilling
lesson.context-and-prop-drilling.summary: Identify when prop drilling becomes painful, lift shared state into React Context, and consume it anywhere in the tree without threading props.
lesson.app-router-basics.title: App Router Basics
lesson.app-router-basics.summary: Understand file-based routing in the App Router: folders are routes, page.js renders the UI, and layout.js wraps every child — no config needed.
lesson.layouts-and-templates.title: Layouts & Templates
lesson.layouts-and-templates.summary: Share persistent UI across routes with layout.js, reset state between navigations with template.js, and nest layouts for complex shells.
lesson.server-vs-client-components.title: Server vs Client Components
lesson.server-vs-client-components.summa: Learn the React Server Component model: what runs on the server, what runs in the browser, and how to draw the boundary with "use client".
lesson.data-fetching-patterns.title: Data Fetching Patterns
lesson.data-fetching-patterns.summary: Fetch data directly in async Server Components, understand Next.js fetch caching, and choose between static, dynamic, and incremental rendering.
lesson.dynamic-routes.title: Dynamic Routes
lesson.dynamic-routes.summary: Create [slug] segments, generate static params at build time with generateStaticParams, and handle catch-all and optional catch-all routes.
lesson.route-handlers.title: Route Handlers
lesson.route-handlers.summary: Build JSON API endpoints with route.js, handle GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE, read request bodies, and return typed Response objects.
lesson.metadata-image-font.title: Metadata, Images & Fonts
lesson.metadata-image-font.summary: Set page titles and Open Graph tags with the metadata API, serve optimised images with next/image, and eliminate layout shift with next/font.
lesson.server-actions.title: Server Actions
lesson.server-actions.summary: Mutate data with "use server" actions called directly from forms, show pending state with useFormStatus, handle errors with useActionState, and revalidate the cache with revalidatePath.
lesson.caching-and-deploy.title: Caching & Deploy
lesson.caching-and-deploy.summary: Understand the four Next.js caches, control static vs dynamic rendering, revalidate on demand, gate routes with middleware, and ship to Vercel.
lesson.loading-and-error-states.title: Loading & Error States
lesson.loading-and-error-states.summary: Add instant loading skeletons with loading.js, catch runtime errors with error.js, and compose Suspense boundaries for granular streaming.
lesson.deploy-and-optimize.title: Deploy & Optimize
lesson.deploy-and-optimize.summary: Push to Vercel, read the build output, set environment variables, enable image optimization, and run Lighthouse to measure real-world performance.

about.title: About
about.headline: Built by developers, for developers
about.mission: Next Academy is a free, open-source course for developers who want to master React and Next.js through hands-on practice — not slides.
about.approach.title: Our approach
about.approach.body: Every lesson starts with working code. You learn faster by reading real patterns, running them, and modifying them than by copying boilerplate from a tutorial.
about.stack.title: The stack
about.stack.body: React 19, Next.js 16 App Router, Tailwind CSS v4, MDX, Shiki, and Sandpack. Everything is modern, opinionated, and production-ready.
about.open.title: Open source
about.open.body: The course content and source code are fully open source. Found a bug or want to contribute a lesson? Open a PR on GitHub.
